d: Frozen by the Sthiti Bandhan; locked shut instead of healed.
Clients of Sthiti Nexus — people who have been through the clinics.
Trapped long-term in the cold system; on the clock forever.
Filed so deep in Pralastrata it’s never meant to be revisited.
Erased into Sahasragard’s records; made to not-exist administratively.
Under Trikaalvalex surveillance; watched across all three times.
